French 75
By: FoodFinds1234
Published: Friday, October 14, 2016 - 9:58am

Ingredients




1 bottle Santa Margherita Prosecco Superiore DOCG
1 fl. Oz gin
¼ freshly squeezed lemon juice
2 teaspoons sugar
Lemon spiral (garnish)

Preparation

1 Combine gin, freshly squeezed lemon juice and sugar in a cocktail shaker with ice and shake well until the sugar dissolves. Strain into an iced flute and top with Santa Margherita Prosecco Superiore DOCG. Garnish with a lemon spiral.

About

Throwback to a classic cocktail the French 75!
Sense the fizzing effect from the bubbly champagne, but try swapping with a Prosecco, which works just as well or even better for this recipe.
